question: PAHAL Scheme is related with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Direct transfer of LPG subsidy.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The PAHAL (DBTL) motive is to **reduce diversion and eliminate duplicate or bogus LPG connections**. 
 
• The scheme was earlier started in 2013 and was **modified in 2015. **
 
• Under the PaHaL scheme, **LPG cylinders are sold at market rates and allow consumers get the subsidy directly into their bank accounts.**
 
• **The government** launched PAHAL (Pratyaksh Hanstantrit Labh) or Direct Benefits Transfer for LPG (DBTL) scheme for LPG consumers across India on** 1 June 2013.**
 
• Under this scheme, the customers require to have an** Aadhaar number for availing of LPG subsidy compulsory.**
